notes.title: Update Using BGS Feedback - Patch Notes Build v.30
notes.notes:
[i]In the past few weeks, we have done our best to incorporate into this build everything we could take from your feedback during our in-person interaction at BGS. We deeply appreciate everyone who visited our booth, and know that we truly value all the information we received. We hope you can feel the improvements in the game as a result of the feedback you gave us.[/i]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/0ef783_2b1e0ee2de724018a96e6bc7ba9a3057~mv2.jpeg[/img]

We will keep bringing updates periodically: level progression, new armor and weapons, new skills, and new doors with new enemies. Please continue sharing your feedback and suggestions with us on [url=https://discord.gg/AXP5R7Q]DISCORD[/url]. https://discord.gg/AXP5R7Q

[h3][h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2][/h3]

[h2]1.COMBAT[/h2]

1.1 Added ranged-attack enemies in the first wave enemy door. These are Mexpers, creatures in the main game that result from genetic experiments used as brute force for heavy labor in Nskita crystal mines. We have included a variation of these creatures that throw charged crystals at Urian.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/0ef783_a67d2e06e5c249ef82f65298a6ca4278~mv2.gif[/img]

1.2 New Counter-Attack system implemented! Now, after Urian pushes, simply press the Block button again, and he will use the first skill from the hotkeys.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/0ef783_730eb2fe8a5f49fc9fadfbd88cb58387~mv2.gif[/img]

1.3 Animation time for Dash adjusted for smoother and faster response.

1.4 Attack speed of strong and weak combos adjusted, as well as the first strike! Now they are faster with a more polished animation.

1.5 Small delay added between Urian's hit reactions, creating more opportunities to evade or counter.

1.6 Added slight displacement to Urian when he gets hit.

1.7 Ice Golem difficulty adjusted, an enemy behind the second door.

[h2]2. OTHERS[/h2]

2.1 Holograms added to identify the enemies behind each door/challenge.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/0ef783_b70e9e7f6f4048ffbd2aa3ee5f6e4777~mv2.png[/img]

2.2 It is now possible to skip the tutorial (for players who haven’t yet played).

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/0ef783_2669c8f2ac7f4b94b203bcc7b7e0ee44~mv2.png[/img]

2.3 Fixed character climbing onto enemies; now this no longer occurs.

2.4 New sound effects added (Mainly: sounds of doors opening within the tutorial and menu sounds).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710049/64f0c07d88e0e0dacbab37adb89c2c2cc1a2987e.png[/img]

notes.title: Fix 004 - Update based on players feedbacks
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Golem's life bar, second door challenge was sometimes not appearing.

notes.title: Fix 003 - Update based on players feedbacks
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that prevented different groups from equipping gauntlets and shields.
- When the character dies facing the Golem, in door 2, he returns to the main HUB, just as in door 1.
- Fixed a fatal error issue when using a health potion right after dying or defeating the Golem.

Improvements:
- Holograms created indicating the enemies that will be challenged at each door the player enters.
- Adjustments to strike hitboxes.

Soon:
- New Armor and Weapons
- New doors and challenges
- New Skills
- Multiplayer

notes.title: Goldilock One: Newsletter #01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710049/0b5b5b498667d59cab4dfce7d31c7b6c6cfbdc2b.gif[/img]
The new demo for BOSS Arena, the free-to-play spin-off of the Goldilock One project, is available on steam now. 
All you need to do is add it to your library and download it, and anyone can try out the new version, which includes several improvements implemented in Unreal 5. Many of these enhancements were based on feedback from previous playtests, such as the ability to customize your own controls and even changes to the fundamental combat mechanics. Join in, provide feedback, and be part of the development process!

[h3]Shocking news on the update[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710049/7b27ba2e47b5e2b91b795768f5bf379670957235.gif[/img]
Now, we have incorporated variations in the visual effects of weapons, depending on the equipped socket. This enhancement is applied to both basic strikes and abilities, providing a more dynamic and personalized visual experience.

[list][*] A rage system has been created, where basic attacks no longer consume energy but recover it. 
[*] Passive recovery has significantly decreased.
[*] Adjustments have been made to basic moves. Lateral strikes have been added and the speed of light and heavy strikes has been increased.
[*] Weapon draw varies, quick when enemies are near and slow when alone.[/list]

[h3]NEWS: Enhancing Controls, Introducing Rage, and Refining Movements![/h3]

All game inputs have been migrated to the new enhanced input system tool, which allows for greater flexibility and is more configurable. Like the combined  joystick shortcuts.

[h3]What’s to come?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710049/75c5bb9a4a760b2ee4d5b1d01647732bf63d80cd.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710049/1a49c9f3bc2d7ef2d1fe4cbb03811e84fca1cace.gif[/img]   
[list][*] Hiring a Companion for the Golem Arena or playing with a friend in Local Multiplayer: This feature is already in the testing phase, and you can check it out on Steam, including using Steam’s Remote Play
[*] A Second Arena with Enemy Waves will be added to the BOSS Arena. This experience will involve waves of enemies and will also be ranked, adding to the available arenas.[/list]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xjDGY5qXE4g

[url=https://discord.gg/2mng9RqN]Join our discord[/url]
[b]HAVE FUN PLAYING! Regards, Goldilock One Team | Espírito Geek[/b]

notes.title: Goldilock One: BOSS ARENA - The Boss Challenge at BGS Event
notes.notes:
** This is a recorded streaming with some highlights from the last event we`ve been together with team.

BOSS Arena is a Spin-Off of Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaíra, it will be a form of “minigame” in a format that seeks a more informal experience associated with the main project of the franchise, which will be an Open World Action RPG with COOP experiences with NPCs and Local Multiplayer.

[i]“If we were to define it, we would say that BOSS Arena is an Arcade appendix to the main project, we started to see people enjoying it at events and decided to try to replicate the experience by transferring some of the emotion we saw in people in person through an online ranking.”[/i] (Will Emmerich - Executive Producer)

[b]Have fun with the Hack and Slash provided by Urian's combos, manage your energy and health while using our Warrior's Special Moves (Skills). Observe your enemy and study the change in behavior, learning the best moments to attack, but also to defend yourself, dodge the blows or use the limited recovery resources.[/b]


* Initially we will have a test arena against an Ice Golem with a selection of different difficulties and an online ranking where you can publish your performance.

** As soon as the main project is published, new arenas can be unlocked according to the evolution of your “Record of Enemies” (Bestiary) throughout your progression in the story mode of the game Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaíra.

*** Although this game has exclusive experiences planned to be included in the future linked to another game that will be a premium game, BOSS Arena was thought to also have some Free experiences, since it was not created with direct financial purpose, but with the intentions of: anticipating feedbacks for the combat system of the final project, involving the community with the project still in development and also creating new forms of fun so that the player, after completing the story mode in the main project, can find a different experience in this game, without exploration but, with a different form of fun.

**** In the future, we are committed to creating new Free experiences to BOSS ARENA as long as we achieve the studio's financial health with the launch of the main project, we are an independent project and we are making this first experience available in good faith, if all goes well we will be able to continue creating new free experiences for the community in parallel with the core development of Premium products.
